setup_distributed_process_group: setup a PyTorch distributed process group using SLURM or local mode with a config dictionary
get_init_method_tcp_or_file: get a TCP or file-based initialization method string for a distributed job with world size and rank
all_reduce_tensor_across_ranks: all reduce a tensor or scalar across all ranks with optional averaging in a distributed group
all_gather_tensors_from_ranks: all gather tensors from all ranks into a list with optional device placement in a distributed group
cleanup_distributed_and_ray: cleanup the distributed process group, shutdown Ray, and release GPU resources with port cleanup
